name: jakgasol
caption:
DEADLINE BIGS 🎮🏀 Two trade deadline deals for a center. Marc Gasol won us a ring. Jakob Poeltl is still chasing one.

• Feb 7, 2019: Gasol arrives from Memphis
• 2019 playoffs: 9.4 PPG, 6.4 RPG, NBA champion
• Gasol, first full season with us (2019-20): 7.5 PPG, 6.3 RPG
• Feb 9, 2023: Poeltl comes back from San Antonio
• Poeltl, first full season back (2023-24): 11.1 PPG, 8.6 RPG, 65.6 FG%

Better center for us: Gasol or Poeltl? 👇

beats.vo: Better numbers, or the ring? Gasol or Poeltl? Comment below.

facts.claim: On February 7, 2019 (Feb 7) Gasol was traded from Memphis to Toronto; NBA champion 2019; 2019-20 was his first full season with Toronto
On February 9, 2023 (Feb 9) Poeltl was traded back to Toronto from San Antonio, so 2023-24 was his first full season back
